patch_description: This version spends evaluations on a diverse set of repaired seeds, then adaptively searches an archive of strong networks. Each parent maintains separate stall counts for focused switches, rotations, and multi-switch kicks; those counts adjust proposal effort independently. LP batches prioritize moves that alter positive-price links, while retaining surrogate-ranked and diverse alternatives. Cached and previously evaluated networks are filtered out before evaluation, so LP budget is reserved for genuinely new topologies.
